e.title: Aegis
e.summary: AI 参数收入保险（零工经济）：零工配送员收入中断的参数化保障
e.body: Aegis 是 AI 驱动的参数收入保险 demo：面向印度零工配送员的收入中断保障——用 AI 数据触发参数赔付。对 RIAA：[[parametric-insurance]] 概念的新兴应用（零工经济）——AI 让参数触发更精细；与 [[zestyai]]（气候参数）、[[actuarial-pricing]]（定价）构成参数保险应用图谱；零工经济是新风险源（[[emerging-risks]]）的活案例。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：仓库描述确认（AI 参数收入保险 demo），未实测
e.summary_en: AI-powered parametric income insurance (gig economy): income-interruption coverage for gig delivery workers
e.summary_hk: AI 參數收入保險（零工經濟）：零工配送員收入中斷的參數化保障
e.body_en: Aegis is an AI-driven parametric income-insurance demo: income-interruption coverage for gig delivery workers in India, with AI data triggering parametric payouts. For RIAA: a new-application case of the [[parametric-insurance]] concept (gig economy) — AI makes parametric triggers finer-grained; with [[zestyai]] (climate parametric) and [[actuarial-pricing]] it forms a parametric-insurance application map; the gig economy is a live case of new risk sources ([[emerging-risks]]).
e.body_hk: Aegis 是 AI 驅動的參數收入保險 demo：面向印度零工配送員的收入中斷保障——用 AI 數據觸發參數賠付。對 RIAA：[[parametric-insurance]] 概念的新興應用（零工經濟）——AI 讓參數觸發更精細；與 [[zestyai]]（氣候參數）、[[actuarial-pricing]]（定價）構成參數保險應用圖譜；零工經濟是新風險源（[[emerging-risks]]）的活案例。
